finalText:
Redis died at 02:14:07, and that killed everything downstream.

The system tried to fall back to direct database reads, but the load spiked immediately — cache miss storms, request timeouts, queue depth blew past 500 (max). For 17 minutes, workers were timing out, the queue kept growing, and then worker-2 ran out of memory at 02:31:44. The supervisor killed the whole process group when the API went unresponsive.

Redis reconnect failed 12 times, so recovery never happened.

Root cause: **Redis connection lost (ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379)** at line 182. Once the cache was gone, your database couldn't handle the request storm that followed.

Fixes to consider: make the database layer handle load better (read replicas, connection pooling), set up Redis failover/clustering, or add circuit breakers that fail fast instead of queueing infinitely.
